_comment: Pinned inputs of the similarity analysis (docs/similarity/METHOD.md). Bumping a version is a reviewed commit: re-check docs/similarity/*.toml (curated judgments and their pinned line ranges), tools/similarity/tuning-pins.json, and refresh tools/similarity/data/foreign-vocab.txt with `tools/similarity/run --refresh-vocab`.

libstdcxx.name: libstdc++
libstdcxx.licence: GNU GPL v3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception (libiberty's demangler: GPL v2 or later with a linking exception, as stated in the file)

libcxx03.name: libc++'s C++03 fork (positive control)
libcxx03.version: LLVM 23.1.2, libcxx/include/__cxx03 (forked from libc++ in 2024 and maintained separately since)

draft.name: C++ working draft sources
draft.licence: used only to build the standard's vocabulary; nothing is shown

kokkos_mdspan.name: Kokkos mdspan reference implementation
kokkos_mdspan.role: style control: an independent modern implementation of mdspan; libc++'s mdspan derives from it (its files carry the Kokkos header), so that pair is derived, not independent

beman_optional.name: Beman project optional
beman_optional.role: style control: an independent C++23 implementation of optional

beman_inplace_vector.name: Beman project inplace_vector
beman_inplace_vector.role: style control: an independent C++26 implementation of inplace_vector
